_comment: One IOS landmark document covering every shape the format has: all eight single-point types, both multi-point types, a basePlane, and teeth in all four FDI quadrants. Read by annotations.tests_ios_landmarks (the Python round-trip) and by frontend/tests (the JS document model), so the two cannot drift. Patient id 7 throughout; the key format is <patientId>_<jaw>_FDI_<tooth>. Coordinates are resource_local -- one mesh's own object space, in millimetres -- and are deliberately awkward floats so a round trip that silently reformats them fails.
